title: The network fee ladder reads 5% Business, 3% Collective, 0% Non Profit, and the stored take_rate row speaks rungs
detail: PHASE 3 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709). NETWORK_TAKE_RATE_DEFAULT paid 500, a new collective rung 300, nonprofit 0; takeRateRungForPlan maps collective (and Non Profit Collective to nonprofit). Free 1000 and the personal rungs stay as default-deny values only. A migration rewrites pricing_settings.take_rate in the rung shape (production still carries plan-named keys). take-rate-ladder.test.ts asserts 500/300/0 and 0 on own audience. Shipped 2026-10-06: NETWORK_TAKE_RATE_DEFAULT is paid 500, collective 300, nonprofit 0; takeRateRungForPlan places collective on its own rung and Non Profit Collective on nonprofit; a Founding Business lock buys the rung down (min of rung and locked_take_bps) through spaceNetworkBps; migration 20270346005300 upserts the stored row in the rung shape; the admin console gains a Collective field; LIVE-230's probe is narrowed to allow the reinstated collective rung.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(f)=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const k=r("lib/billing/pricing-keys.ts");const d=(k.split("NETWORK_TAKE_RATE_DEFAULT: NetworkTakeRate = {")[1]||"").split("}")[0];if(!/paid:\s*500/.test(d))fail("paid rung is not 500");if(!/collective:\s*300/.test(d))fail("no collective rung at 300");if(!/case \x27collective\x27/.test((k.split("export function takeRateRungForPlan")[1]||"").split("\n}")[0]))fail("takeRateRungForPlan does not place collective");const mig=fs.readdirSync("supabase/migrations").filter((f)=>f>"20270346002700").map((f)=>r("supabase/migrations/"+f)).join("\n");if(!/take_rate[\s\S]{0,400}"paid":\s*500/.test(mig))fail("no migration rewrites the stored take_rate in the rung shape");console.log("ok: the fee ladder is 500/300/0")'
